subject: Pen test report & vuln management follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / pen test items and next steps

Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we’re aligned on scope and timelines: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned FinHealth is finalizing SOC 2 Type II for 2026 and will have a completed report by end of Q4. Please confirm whether a SOC 2 bridge letter will be available earlier.
- GDPR/HIPAA: you confirmed that PHI may be present in a small subset of test data; we flagged the need for our HIPAA addendum and dataflow diagram.
- Vendor security questionnaire: FinHealth asked us to kick off the vendor questionnaire. I’ll start the questionnaire in your portal and copy SecurityOps.
- Pen test report: you requested a recent pen test report and details on our vulnerability management process (scan cadence, SLA for disclosure/remediation, and backlog/triage flow).

Next steps (as discussed):
1) I will share a redacted pen test report and our vuln management SLA by Friday (attaching the draft SLA).
2) Alex, you’ll confirm whether a redacted vendor pen test report is acceptable or if FinHealth requires the full report under NDA.
3) If FinHealth needs the full report, we’ll route through our legal/NDA process and share via secure Drive link.

Attached: draft Vulnerability Management SLA (Vuln_SLA_Draft.docx)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the redacted report once I have sign-off from our security team.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0179

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SecurityOps <secops@finhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / pen test items and next steps

Thanks Marissa — useful summary. A few follow-ups: 

1) Timeline: can you confirm the ETA for the redacted pen test report and the SLA doc? We’re hoping to review by next Tuesday to keep our procurement timeline intact.
2) SOC 2: a bridge letter would be ideal prior to the full Type II report; is that something Redwood can provide?
3) Full report vs redacted: FinHealth security prefers the full report but only after a mutual NDA — otherwise the redacted version is fine for initial review. If you need specifics on redaction level, we typically accept findings + summary (with exploit PoC removed).

Also please include a short note on your scanning cadence (internal weekly scans? quarterly third-party scans?) so our GRC team can evaluate risk.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Security, FinHealth
alex.johnson@finhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / pen test items and next steps

Alex — quick update: 

- Attached is a redacted copy of our most recent pen test (FinHealth_pen_test_report_2026-09_redacted.pdf). The redactions remove active exploit code, customer-specific PoCs, and internal IPs.
- Our vuln management process (high-level):
  • Continuous internal SAST/DAST + weekly automated network scans
  • Quarterly third-party pen tests (last completed Sept 2026)
  • Severity triage: Critical (24–72hr SLA for acknowledgement & mitigation plan), High (7–14 days), Medium/Low (documented backlog and SLA by category)
  • Disclosure: we provide a redacted report to prospects in 1–2 business days; full report is provided under NDA and with a signed data-sharing addendum.

Timing: I’ll upload the redacted PDF to a secure Drive link and share by end of day today. If FinHealth wants the full report, we’ll initiate NDA routing — Rishi, can you confirm the legal contact to route full-report NDA?

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: FinHealth_pen_test_report_2026-09_redacted.pdf
From: SecurityOps <secops@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / pen test items and next steps

Thanks for the report, Marissa — quick clarifying questions from our team:

- Who owns remediation for third-party findings discovered in your environment? Is it fully owned by Redwood engineering, or do you expect customer involvement?
- For the weekly automated scans, can you provide the most recent scan summary (last 30 days)?
- If we require the full report under NDA, what is the typical turnaround for Redwood to approve and send the full PDF?

If you can point us to a folder with the scan summaries and the contact for legal/NDAs, that would speed review.

—FinHealth Security Ops
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>, SecurityOps <secops@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / pen test items and next steps

Hi Alex / FinHealth team — looping in our security & legal leads to expedite this: 

- Remediation ownership: Redwood engineering owns remediation for vulnerabilities in our platform. For any customer-specific configuration issues or integration-level risks we’ll coordinate on mitigation and provide clear owners/timelines.
- Scan summaries: I uploaded the 30-day scan summary and related artifacts to the secure Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefGHIjkLmnoP (read-only link).
- Full report under NDA: our legal typically approves standard mutual NDA within 2 business days; once NDA is in place we will deliver the full pen test PDF within 1 business day via secure transfer (we can also use DocuSign/secure portal if required).

For next steps:
1) Alex — please confirm whether FinHealth prefers us to send a proposed mutual NDA or if your legal team will initiate.
2) Marissa — please share the Vuln_SLA_Draft and redacted report link to the FinHealth SecurityOps alias and HubSpot deal (DEAL-7891).

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
